title: 酬程延秋夜即事见赠
title_en: Replying to Cheng Yan, Who Sent Me a Poem on an Autumn Night
author: 韩翃

readings.zh: 这里按格律应读平声 kān，现在一般读 kàn。
readings.en: The meter wants a level tone here, kān, but today it is usually read kàn.

glosses.en: cháng diàn: a long mat woven from bamboo, for sleeping on.

glosses.zh: 迎风早：早早地就迎来了凉风，秋天的凉意来得早。
glosses.en: yíng fēng zǎo: the cool wind arrives early; autumn chill comes soon.

glosses.zh: 空城：夜里安静、好像没有人的城。
glosses.en: kōng chéng: the city at night, so quiet it seems empty.

glosses.zh: 澹（dàn）：淡淡的、轻轻流动的样子。月华：月光。
glosses.en: dàn yuè huá: dàn means pale and gently moving; yuè huá means moonlight.

glosses.zh: 星河：银河，夜空里那条由许多星星组成的光带。
glosses.en: xīng hé: the Milky Way, the band of stars across the night sky.

glosses.zh: 砧（zhēn）杵（chǔ）：捶洗衣服用的石板和木棒。古人秋天捶衣服、准备冬衣，夜里常能听到这种声音。
glosses.en: zhēn chǔ: the stone block and wooden club used to pound cloth. In autumn people pounded cloth to make winter clothes, and the sound was often heard at night.
jié hòu: the season, the time of year.

glosses.zh: 看应晚：看来应该已经是深秋了。
glosses.en: kàn yīng wǎn: it looks as if it must already be late in the season.

glosses.zh: 心期：心里盼望的事，这里指和朋友相会的心愿。
glosses.en: xīn qī: what the heart hopes for; here, the wish to meet the friend.

glosses.zh: 赊（shē）：远，遥远。卧亦赊：躺着想也觉得很遥远。
glosses.en: wò yì shē: shē means far away. Even lying in bed thinking of it, it feels far off.
xiàng lái: just now, a moment ago.

glosses.zh: 秀句：优美的诗句，这里指程延送来的诗。
glosses.en: xiù jù: beautiful lines of poetry; here, the poem Cheng Yan sent.

glosses.zh: 鸣鸦：乌鸦叫了，说明天快亮了。
glosses.en: míng yā: the crows begin to caw, which means dawn is near.

translation.zh: 躺在长竹席上，早早就感到了秋风的凉意。
translation.en: Lying on my long bamboo mat, I feel the autumn wind come early.

translation.zh: 安静的城里，淡淡的月光在流动。
translation.en: Over the quiet city, pale moonlight drifts.

translation.zh: 秋夜的银河下，一只大雁飞过。
translation.en: Under the Milky Way on this autumn night, a single wild goose flies by.

translation.zh: 夜里，千家万户都传来捶衣服的声音。
translation.en: All night, from a thousand homes, comes the sound of pounding cloth.

translation.zh: 看这时节，应该已经是深秋了。
translation.en: Judging by the season, it must already be late autumn.

translation.zh: 心里想和你相见，躺着想来也觉得遥远。
translation.en: I long to see you, but lying here, that meeting feels far away.

translation.zh: 我刚才一直在吟诵你写的好诗，
translation.en: I have been reading your fine lines aloud,

translation.zh: 不知不觉，乌鸦已经叫了，天快亮了。
translation.en: and before I knew it the crows were cawing; dawn had come.

background.zh: 程延是韩翃的朋友，生平不详。他在一个秋夜写了一首《秋夜即事》寄给韩翃，“即事”就是写眼前看到的事。韩翃读了以后，写下这首诗回赠他，“酬”就是回赠、答谢的意思。诗写于哪一年，已经不能确定。一说“程延”应作“程近”。
background.en: Cheng Yan was a friend of Han Hong; little is known about him. One autumn night he wrote a poem about what he saw around him and sent it to Han Hong. After reading it, Han Hong wrote this poem in reply. The word chóu in the title means to answer a gift with a gift. We no longer know the year it was written. Another view says the friend's name should be Cheng Jin.

author_note.zh: 韩翃，字君平，唐代诗人，是“大历十才子”之一。“大历十才子”是唐代宗大历年间很有名的十位诗人。他的诗清丽优美，最有名的是《寒食》里的“春城无处不飞花”。这首诗也写得清淡细致，很见他的风格。
author_note.en: Han Hong, also called Junping, was a Tang poet and one of the Ten Talents of the Dali era, ten well-known poets of the reign of Emperor Daizong. His poems are clear and graceful. His best-known line is "In the spring city, there is no place where blossoms do not fly", from "Cold Food Day". This poem shows the same light, careful style.

appreciation.zh: 前四句像一幅秋夜的画：竹席上的凉风，空城上的月光，银河下一只孤雁，千家万户的捶衣声。有看到的，有听到的，也有身上感到的，写得很安静，却有一点冷清。“一雁”和“千家”放在一起，一个孤单，一个热闹，让人更觉得寂寞。后四句转到心里：秋已深了，想见朋友却见不到。最后说自己读朋友的诗读了一整夜，直到乌鸦叫了才发觉天亮。诗人没有直接说“我很想你”，可是读诗读到天亮，这份情谊已经说得清清楚楚。
appreciation.en: The first four lines paint an autumn night: a cool wind on the bamboo mat, moonlight over the empty city, one goose under the Milky Way, and the sound of pounding cloth from a thousand homes. There are things seen, things heard and things felt on the skin. It is quiet, and a little lonely. One goose next to a thousand homes sets one lonely thing beside a busy crowd, which makes the loneliness stronger. The last four lines turn inward. Autumn is deep, and he cannot see his friend. Then he says he read his friend's poem all night, until the crows told him it was dawn. He never says "I miss you", but reading until sunrise says it clearly.
